_comment: Human-equivalent rates for timesheet.py --mode human. Minutes a professional human tester with Odoo experience would spend per activity found in the logs. Each team copies this file and changes the numbers; the file path and every rate are written into the workbook's Method sheet. Sources: tool = a tool call (regex on the tool name, optional regex on its input); file = distinct files changed by the matching tools; commit = git commits in the block; request = typed requests matching the regex. Identical repeated tool calls count once (the agent iterating is not new work); set "distinct": false on an activity to count every call. A block with nothing counted is 0 h; block_minimum_minutes lifts a block where something was done. Unit test runs (pytest) are developer work, not tester scenarios, so they are not counted here.
rule: Bill what a professional human tester with Odoo experience would spend on the work done, not how long the agent ran.

task_multiplier._comment: Optional ticket complexity per task id, e.g. "1002": 1.5
